theory.overview: Suffix trees and suffix arrays are powerful data structures for string processing. Suffix tree is a compressed trie of all suffixes of a string, enabling efficient substring search, pattern matching, and longest common substring. Suffix array is a sorted array of all suffix indices, more space-efficient than suffix tree. Used in bioinformatics (DNA analysis), text editors, and search engines. This chapter covers suffix tree construction, suffix array, and their applications.

sections.title: Suffix Tree
sections.content: Compressed trie containing all suffixes of string. Each edge labeled with substring. Internal nodes represent common prefixes. All suffixes end at leaves (or marked). Construction: Ukkonen's algorithm in $O(n)$ time. Space: $O(n)$. Enables $O(m)$ substring search where m is pattern length.

sections.title: Suffix Array
sections.content: Sorted array of suffix starting indices. For string 'banana': [5,3,1,0,4,2] (a, ana, anana, banana, na, nana). Construction: naive $O(n^2 \log n)$, SA-IS $O(n)$, prefix doubling $O(n \log^2 n)$. Space: $O(n)$. Used with LCP array for efficient substring operations.

sections.title: LCP Array
sections.content: Longest Common Prefix array. LCP[i] = longest common prefix of suffixes at SA[i] and SA[i-1]. Kasai's algorithm computes LCP in $O(n)$. Used with suffix array for substring search, longest repeated substring, and longest common substring of two strings.
sections.algorithm: Kasai's algorithm: compute LCP in O(n) using rank array.

sections.title: Applications
sections.content: Substring search: find pattern in text using suffix array + LCP. Longest repeated substring: max LCP value. Longest common substring of two strings: concatenate with separator, build suffix array, find max LCP across separator. Pattern matching in genome sequences.

sections.title: Suffix Tree vs Suffix Array
sections.content: Suffix tree: $O(n)$ construction (Ukkonen), $O(m)$ search, $O(n)$ space. More complex to implement. Suffix array: $O(n)$ or $O(n \log^2 n)$ construction, $O(m \log n)$ search with binary search, $O(n)$ space. Simpler, more space-efficient. Choose based on use case.

keyConcepts.name: Compressed Trie
keyConcepts.description: Trie with no single-child nodes (edges merged). Reduces space and improves efficiency.

keyConcepts.name: Ukkonen's Algorithm
keyConcepts.description: Linear-time suffix tree construction. Builds tree incrementally, maintaining active point and suffix links.

keyConcepts.name: LCP
keyConcepts.description: Longest Common Prefix between consecutive suffixes in sorted order. Enables efficient substring operations.
keyConcepts.use: With suffix array for substring search

keyConcepts.name: Rank Array
keyConcepts.description: Inverse of suffix array: rank[i] = position of suffix starting at i in suffix array. Used in LCP computation.

steps.title: Generate Suffixes
steps.description: Generate all suffixes of string (indices or actual strings).
steps.code: suffixes = [(s[i:], i) for i in range(len(s))];

steps.title: Sort Suffixes
steps.description: Sort suffixes lexicographically to build suffix array.
steps.code: suffixes.sort(key=lambda x: x[0]); sa = [i for _, i in suffixes];

steps.title: Compute LCP
steps.description: Compute LCP array using Kasai's algorithm (rank array + suffix array).
steps.code: rank = [0] * n; for i, idx in enumerate(sa): rank[idx] = i; lcp = kasai(s, sa, rank);

steps.title: Search
steps.description: Binary search in suffix array to find pattern. Use LCP to narrow search.

steps.title: Query
steps.description: Answer queries: longest repeated substring, longest common substring, etc.

practiceProblems.title: Longest Repeated Substring
practiceProblems.description: Find longest substring that appears at least twice.
practiceProblems.solution: Suffix array + LCP. Longest repeated substring = suffix with max LCP.

practiceProblems.title: Longest Common Substring
practiceProblems.description: Find longest common substring of two strings.
practiceProblems.solution: Concatenate with separator, build suffix array, find max LCP across separator.
practiceProblems.hints: Concatenate with separator, find max LCP across separator

practiceProblems.title: Shortest Palindrome
practiceProblems.description: Shortest palindrome by adding characters in front.
practiceProblems.solution: KMP on s + '#' + reverse(s). Find longest prefix of reverse that matches suffix of s.

practiceProblems.title: Repeated Substring Pattern
practiceProblems.description: Check if string can be constructed by repeating a substring.
practiceProblems.solution: KMP LPS array. If n % (n - lps[n-1]) == 0 and lps[n-1] > 0, true.

practiceProblems.title: Implement strStr()
practiceProblems.description: Find first occurrence of needle in haystack.
practiceProblems.solution: KMP algorithm. Build LPS array for needle, then search.

practiceProblems.title: Repeated DNA Sequences
practiceProblems.description: Find all 10-letter sequences occurring more than once in DNA.
practiceProblems.solution: Rolling hash or hash set. Slide window of size 10.

practiceProblems.title: Add and Search Word
practiceProblems.description: Add word and search with '.' wildcard.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie. For search with '.', try all children recursively.

practiceProblems.title: Word Search II
practiceProblems.description: Find all words from dictionary in board.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie + DFS. Build Trie from dictionary. DFS from each cell.

practiceProblems.title: Word Break
practiceProblems.description: Check if string can be segmented into dictionary words.
practiceProblems.solution: DP. dp[i] = true if s[0:i] can be segmented. Trie for prefix check.

practiceProblems.title: Word Squares
practiceProblems.description: Find all word squares (k×k grid where row i = column i as words).
practiceProblems.solution: Trie + backtracking. Build square row by row.

practiceProblems.title: Stream of Characters
practiceProblems.description: Check if any suffix of stream is in word list.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie of reversed words. Maintain stream, check if any suffix matches.

practiceProblems.title: Design Add and Search Words
practiceProblems.description: Optimized version with word length grouping.
practiceProblems.solution: Group words by length. For search, only check words of same length.

practiceProblems.title: Replace Words
practiceProblems.description: Replace words with shortest prefix from dictionary.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie for dictionary. For each word, find shortest prefix.

practiceProblems.title: Longest Word in Dictionary
practiceProblems.description: Longest word that can be built one character at a time from other words.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie with isEnd. Sort words by length then lexicographically. Check if all prefixes exist.

practiceProblems.title: Implement Magic Dictionary
practiceProblems.description: Search word with exactly one character different.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie. For search, try changing each character, check if new word exists.

practiceProblems.title: Design Search Autocomplete System
practiceProblems.description: Autocomplete with top 3 historical suggestions.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie with top 3 suggestions at each node. Update on '#'.
practiceProblems.hints: Trie with top 3 at each node

practiceProblems.title: Concatenated Words
practiceProblems.description: Find all words that can be formed by concatenating two or more words.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie + DP. For each word, check if can be split into other words using Trie.

practiceProblems.title: Maximum XOR of Two Numbers
practiceProblems.description: Find maximum XOR of any two numbers in array.
practiceProblems.solution: Bit Trie (32 bits). For each number, find best match for maximum XOR.

practiceProblems.title: Prefix and Suffix Search
practiceProblems.description: Design WordFilter with f(prefix, suffix) returning word.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie with all prefix#suffix combinations for each word.

practiceProblems.title: Map Sum Pairs
practiceProblems.description: Insert(key, value) and sum(prefix) returning sum of all keys with prefix.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie with sum at each node. Update sums on insert.
practiceProblems.hints: Trie with sum at each node

practiceProblems.title: Design Add and Search Words Data Structure
practiceProblems.description: Optimized version with word length grouping.
practiceProblems.solution: Group words by length for efficiency.

practiceProblems.title: Design In-Memory File System
practiceProblems.description: Implement ls (list) and mkdir (create directory).
practiceProblems.solution: Trie-like structure where nodes are directories/files.

practiceProblems.title: Design File System
practiceProblems.description: Implement createPath and getPath with file content.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie with isFile flag and content.

practiceProblems.title: Palindrome Pairs
practiceProblems.description: Find all pairs of words that concatenate to form palindrome.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie of reversed words. For each word, check all possible palindrome splits.

practiceProblems.title: Short Encoding of Words
practiceProblems.description: Find minimum length encoding where no word is prefix of another's encoding.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie. Words that are prefixes of others don't need separate encoding.
